EFS/S18.title: Android debug build on the local stack: permissions denied, offline at an AI step, empty states
EFS/S18.detail: Android rig: debug build of main e02167f bundled for the LOCAL stack only (bundle names 127.0.0.1:4510/4511, reached through adb reverse), built outside the checkout, on the rc_api36 emulator (Pixel 7, Android 16); Playwright attached to the app's own WebView; every ai/* action the app sends is answered or failed at the WebView's socket (no model call; aiCallLog had no new row in any run). Android half, judged 17/25 (8 fail). The account was set to the physicians' cloud engine (the shared test fixture had given it the on-device test marker), so Dictate went getUserMedia + prepareSession; prepareSession was held and failed at the WebView socket, never forwarded (no OpenAI session). PASSED: state 1 empty lists with + / scan in both contexts; state 2 a chart with no notes shows plain empty states; microphone denied at Android's prompt ('Allow Round Companion to record audio?' -> Don't allow; after two denials Android stops asking): Dictate in the pre-round editor, the encounter recorder and Ask AI, Hospital and Nursing Home, each shows 'Microphone access is blocked … open Settings › Round Companion, then tap Dictate again', keeps the typed text, no crash (6/6); granted again in Settings, Dictate gets the microphone and asks for the session (no 'blocked' message); camera denied causes no crash (3/3); offline Save Note keeps the text, and back online the save and summary finish by themselves (Q2: recorded). FAILED (8): (a) camera denied - tapping 'Take Photo or Choose Image' (Hospital / Nursing Home scan) or 'Photograph' (Previous Notes) shows no message at all, the button just does nothing (3/3); (b) camera granted - all three controls open Android's photo picker, never the camera (3/3; the manifest has no <queries> entry for the image-capture intent, so Capacitor falls back to the file picker); (c) offline at Save Note in the full-screen pre-round editor the physician sees only an endless 'Saving & Updating…' spinner and no message: the 'No network connection …' banner is rendered but hidden behind the full-screen editor (in the DOM, not on screen) until the network returns (2 checks: visible message, no endless spinner). Also seen: 'Dictation done — review before saving' next to the microphone-blocked message (known B27); the message's 'tap the lock icon in the address bar' does not apply in the app (suggestion). Rig note: airplane mode alone does not cut the emulator's adb-reverse link and Android WebView keeps navigator.onLine true, so 'offline' was made by closing the app's Convex socket (airplane mode on as well). Left for a physical phone: (3) dictating when the network drops mid-sentence, (6) the session ending mid-dictation, (7) a lock mid-dictation (real speech + live transcription), the photo-library picks (non-census / unreadable image need the live vision model), and the whole iOS half.
EFS/S18.productIssue: On Android a physician cannot take a photo from the app: the census scan and Previous Notes 'Photograph' open the photo picker instead of the camera; if the camera permission was denied, the same buttons silently do nothing with no message saying how to allow the camera. Offline, Save Note in the full-screen pre-round editor spins 'Saving & Updating…' with no visible explanation (the no-network banner is hidden behind the editor).
